title: 4 Perplexity workflows I'd pick again
caption:
4 Perplexity workflows I'd pick again

The exact stack behind this:
1️⃣ Add a timeframe — 'Best AI note tools for consultants, 2026' — vague questions get vague, unquotable answers.
2️⃣ Click every citation — Open the source before you quote a number. One wrong stat kills the whole post's credibility.
3️⃣ Use Pro for depth — Multi-source reads when one page can't settle it — worth it for pillar content you'll repurpose.
4️⃣ Facts → stat slides — Cited numbers become your carousel's stat slides: research and content from one query.
